title: pool-ops 1:1 agenda + runbook scratchpad
body:
Purpose: prep notes for upcoming 1:1 with M (capacity owner) — align on short runway actions, ask for decision on commit vs burst tradeoffs, and surface risky forecast assumptions.

Quick context (tl;dr):
- Current committed pool: 40 A100-80GB equiv (region: us-west-2) + 12 burst nodes on Dedicated.
- Avg sustained utilization (last 30d): 68% (peak daily p95: 91% at model deploy spikes).
- Near-term events: Marketing demo (Mar 20–22) + partner POC (starts Apr 1) expected to add ~1.8M tokens/day => ~6–8% utilization increase.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick status (5m): utilization, recent incidents, any outages from autoscale failures.
2) Forecast sanity check (10m): review scenarios A/B/C, ask for target headroom %.
3) Autoscale tuning proposal (10m): list of params to change and expected impact.
4) Decisions & next steps (5m): commit ask, who owns execution, timeline.

My questions to M (explicit):
- Do we want to keep target operational headroom at 20% or shift to 15% for next quarter to save cost? Pros/cons from sales/CS?
- Are we ready to expand commit in us-west-2 by +10 A100-eq or prefer to lean on burst for next 6 weeks?
- Acceptance criteria for me to run the autoscale tweaks in prod (metrics to watch / rollback thresholds).

Forecast scenarios (work-in-progress):
- Scenario A (conservative): no new POCs, steady growth +5% M/M -> need +6 GPUs committed by May to maintain 20% headroom.
- Scenario B (mid): partner POC converts with 1k qps steady by June -> need +14 GPUs by June or rely on burst (cost delta ~+22% if bursting frequently).
- Scenario C (upside): marketing demo drives short spike (3 days) then a small baseline lift -> prefer to rely on burst + autoscale if burst policy OK.

Assumptions called out (check these in 1:1):
- Token-to-GPU-hour conversion: using avg 130k tokens / GPU-hour for our mix (p95 sequences trimmed), but this varies by model.
- Burst pool billing: $/GPU-hour ~ 1.9x vs committed effective cost after discount.
- If utilization >85% for >6h/day for 3 consecutive days -> treat as sustained and push to commit decision.

Autoscale tuning proposal (short list):
- Min nodes: keep at 32 (avoid cold-start for routing).
- Max nodes: raise from 60 -> 72 for 2-week pilot to absorb demo spikes.
- Scale-up policy: lower aggregation window from 120s -> 45s for fast spikes caused by demos. Test in canary first.
- Scale-down grace: increase from 300s -> 600s to avoid oscillation from short spikes.
- Burst breach fallback: if burst usage >25% of total tokens in a day, auto-notify and cap burst until manual review.

Metrics to watch during pilot (and dashboards to open in 1:1):
- Node utilization histogram (5m), queue length, mean request latency (tail p99), token/sec throughput.
- Cost metric: burst vs committed GPU-hour ratio daily and weekly.
- Error signals: rate of OOMs, rate-limit errors, inference kernel failures.

Quick runbook snippets (to copy into proper playbook later):
- If p95 latency > 2.5x baseline and queue length > 50 for 10m -> escalate to SRE and increase max-nodes immediately (temp override).
- If burst spend > budget cap ($8k/day) -> pause burst reservations for that region and notify finance + product.
- If commit decision is approved -> timeline: procurement (2d), infra config + canary (3d), DNS/traffic routing checks (1d), full rollout (1d).

Open items / risks (for discussion):
- Model mix shift: new LLM in staging has 2x token-GPU cost; if it ships we need to adjust forecast quickly. Who owns that signal? (CC: Noah)
- Sales-led POC may want guaranteed latency SLA; committed GPUs are more defensible — escalate to M for sign-off if POC expected to ramp.
- Concurrency limits in runtime may hide true latency if we cap in router; need to verify router telemetry is reliable.

Immediate action items (mine, post-1:1):
- (P1) Run quick historical backfill to produce 60/90/120 day utilization charts and upload to Confluence (due: Mar 14).
- (P2) Create PR for autoscale pilot changes to infra-config (draft) and link in this doc (due: Mar 16).
- (P3) Draft short note to finance with cost delta scenarios for commit vs burst and proposed budget ask (due: Mar 18).

Delegated / coordination asks to bring up in 1:1:
- Ask SRE to agree on rollback runbook before enabling faster scale-up window (owner: Liam).
- Request product to confirm POC SLAs and expected QPS shape (owner: Noah).

Notes to self (quick heuristics):
- If we can avoid committing extra GPUs and stay at 15% headroom, we save ~ $52k/month (rough calc) but increase risk during multi-day spikes.
- Prioritize small safe changes that reduce tail risk (longer scale-down, higher max nodes) before big $$$ commits.

Random scratch thoughts (keep for brainstorming):
- Could we offer customers a temporary dedicated burst pool as a paid add-on (reserve for 1–4 weeks) to avoid commitment decisions? Quick ops/finance discussion needed.
- Explore per-route guarantees (pin heavy customers to separate pool) to reduce overall headroom needs.

End notes: want to leave meeting with a clear decision on whether to increase max_nodes for 2-week pilot and a follow-up timeline for commit ask.

Follow-ups (after meeting):
- Post summary + decisions in #infra-capacity and update Confluence page with final numbers.
- Schedule a 30m follow-up in two weeks to assess pilot metrics.

-- Priya
